message.content: {"note_claim": "The Daily Mail headline adds that MBS is \"terrified\" and \"forced into hiding,\" language absent from the WSJ report it cites.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Saudi Arabia 's terrified Crown Prince has been forced into hiding as Houthi rebels continue to hit Riyadh with deadly missile strikes, a report has claimed.", "reason": "The Daily Mail page itself uses \"terrified\" and \"forced into hiding\" in its own voice, while the WSJ-sourced quote from Saudi officials only says he is 'shuttling between heavily guarded palaces equipped with bunkers', so the added language is Daily Mail's own."}

parsed.note_claim: The Daily Mail headline adds that MBS is "terrified" and "forced into hiding," language absent from the WSJ report it cites.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Saudi Arabia 's terrified Crown Prince has been forced into hiding as Houthi rebels continue to hit Riyadh with deadly missile strikes, a report has claimed.
parsed.reason: The Daily Mail page itself uses "terrified" and "forced into hiding" in its own voice, while the WSJ-sourced quote from Saudi officials only says he is 'shuttling between heavily guarded palaces equipped with bunkers', so the added language is Daily Mail's own.
